issues.title: App crashes or won't open
issues.summary: Reviewers report the app crashes or gets stuck on the loading screen and won't open after an update.

issues.title: Login and password issues
issues.summary: Reviewers say the app won't accept their password or let them log into their account.

issues.title: General restrictions complaint
issues.summary: A reviewer complains that the app has too many restrictions.

issues.title: Free users can't control playback
issues.summary: Reviewers complain that basic playback controls like choosing a song, skipping freely, replaying, or seeking within a track now require Premium, leaving free playback limited to shuffled songs with a capped number of skips.

issues.title: Lyrics missing for some songs
issues.summary: Reviewers note that lyrics display inconsistently, appearing for some songs but not others.

issues.title: Missing songs or genres in catalog
issues.summary: Reviewers say certain songs or music genres, such as gospel, are not available in the app.

issues.title: Recommendations and playlist suggestions
issues.summary: Reviewers comment on the recommended songs feature, with some wanting to avoid it while playing playlists and others noting changes in the types of songs suggested.

issues.title: Downloads get stuck
issues.summary: A reviewer reports that background song downloads get stuck until the app is opened.

issues.title: Offline mode not working
issues.summary: A reviewer reports that offline playback is not working.

issues.title: General dissatisfaction with the app
issues.summary: Reviewers express overall negative sentiment about the app, including low ratings and disappointment, especially after recent updates.

issues.title: Audio adjustment bugs
issues.summary: A reviewer reports a bug where music adjustment settings don't work properly.

issues.title: Wifi connection and sound quality issues
issues.summary: A reviewer reports being unable to connect over wifi (though mobile data works) and notes poor song quality compared to another music app.

issues.title: Google Assistant playback issue
issues.summary: A reviewer reports that using Google Assistant to play Spotify shows a playing status but doesn't actually play songs.

issues.title: Playback stops and skips unexpectedly
issues.summary: A reviewer reports that songs stop halfway through and the app moves on to a new song instead of resuming.

issues.title: Too many and too loud ads
issues.summary: Reviewers complain that free listening is interrupted by frequent, loud ads that make the app feel unusable without Premium.

issues.title: Disliked homescreen and UX redesign
issues.summary: Reviewers dislike recent major interface updates, particularly a new homescreen layout that feels like a social media feed rather than a music browsing experience.

note: Membership is assigned by code from the enriched subtopic; the model only names issues.
